title: feat(nsopy): opposite-lock y-probe unique vector: reverse UNDEFINED, face UNDEFINED
science: Neighbour-lock vector readout on opposite-lock y-probes. A=(0,1,0) is a tick-0 seed and its already-recorded neighbour list is EMPTY, so L(A)=UNDEFINED. Direct counterpart to #7116/#7119/#7132, which run the same readout on a tick-0 seed probe but add a same-tick peer exception and therefore obtain a defined L(A) and a `fail` rather than `UNDEFINED` reverse.
